comment: Payload families for run_truth.mjs (DESIGN section 7 item 1). Data only: add a family object to extend the set. 'segments' are the key segments written through a row's template; 'array_wrapping' says whether the one-element-array variant of the family is also run for rows whose call has array_segments true. 'value' is written at the end of every attack payload; 'control' is the benign payload run through the same template.
